trigger: inspect, configure, verify, checkout recovery, runtime recovery, or focused validation returns nonzero/incomplete state
dependencies: 30k opencode-lsp domain and selected failure-recovery route are current
repair remains inside the harness-owned failure boundary
steps: for WRONG_REPOSITORY route through the registered checkout recovery router, which resolves the fresh canonical default branch/head and delegates to the bounded checkout resolver

for OPENCODE_NOT_FOUND route through the registered runtime recovery router; require LOCALAPPDATA so recovery and Inspect share the canonical AgentSwitchboard shim/state root, and separate WSL command discovery from version health so an existing but unhealthy OpenCode command is not mistaken for a usable runtime
validate discovered OpenCode versions through the exact safe command path returned by discovery rather than a second name lookup

if OpenCode is absent or its bounded version probe times out/fails, perform one bounded OpenCode-only install through the official installer pinned to $HOME/.opencode/bin, give that managed directory PATH precedence, then independently rediscover and validate the exact command path/version before writing the canonical AgentSwitchboard shim

after runtime recovery run initialization, write opencode-runtime-recovery.json and opencode-runtime-recovery.md for every terminal runtime stage including failures before Inspect; persist stage/exit/output-presence only, not raw command output, environment dumps, credentials, or inherited OpenCode configuration

if the newest parseable receipt for the requested WSL distribution proves OPENCODE_POST_INSTALL_MISSING after a nonzero official-installer exit, use the registered release-pinned retry exactly once: atomically claim that source run before network or installer mutation, preserve the source/runtime evidence unchanged, resolve one validated semantic OpenCode release on the Windows host through the bounded GitHub releases API, forward only VERSION through temporary WSLENV state, recheck that no newer same-distribution receipt superseded the source, re-enter the current canonical bootstrap, bind every new same-distribution runtime run in the retry artifact, and restore VERSION/WSLENV afterward
do not delegate OPENCODE_NOT_FOUND or unhealthy runtime repair to broad technician setup or install unrelated agent tools such as AGY
bound network-backed OpenCode installation and the automatic Inspect handoff and fail with named timeout/dependency boundaries instead of hanging indefinitely
never emit the same failing gate as its own next action when a bounded owned resolver or repair route exists
repair the first owned failing boundary only
never weaken repository identity, privacy, config-preservation, immutable-output, or validator gates
rerun the failed gate first, then the focused floor
outputs: repaired exact-head validation or named external blocker
failurePolicy: stop when repair requires product code, credentials, confidential data on a free endpoint, unsupported upstream runtime, missing bounded-install prerequisites, the evidence-gated release-pinned retry has already been attempted once, its atomic source claim already exists, its source receipt becomes stale before dispatch, or another owner's mutation
handoff: record owner, dependency, artifact path, exact head, and executable next action; observation-only or same-state retry commands are insufficient when a bounded owned resolver or repair route exists
proofCeiling: same as the repaired gate; failure recovery does not promote proof
